name: caspar-av
description: CasparCG show control server — cue lists, AMCP bridging and OSC control. Note: Two things a Rust-only Dockerfile gets wrong here. `web/` is NOT tracked in git — console/vite.config.ts builds into ../web with emptyOutDir — so the image needs a Node stage before the Rust one or it ships a server whose ServeDir points at nothing and 404s every page. And `--web` defaults to the relative path `web`, which resolves against the working directory, so the runtime stage passes an absolute /app/web rather than relying on WORKDIR.
